sentences.text: Everything in this lesson turns on one legal phrase: passenger for hire.
Get it wrong and you’re running an illegal charter.
A passenger for hire is a passenger for whom consideration is contributed as a condition of carriage.
Consideration means money, or any other economic benefit, given directly or indirectly.
But federal law carves out one thing: the voluntary sharing of a trip’s actual expenses.
Friends splitting fuel and bait isn’t consideration.
And owners, crew, and true non-paying guests aren’t passengers for hire either.
Your neighbor says, take me and my buddies out Saturday, and we’ll each give you a hundred dollars.
The payment is a condition of going.
And it doesn’t matter what you call it.
A donation, a club membership, a required fuel charge: if they have to pay to come, they’re passengers for hire.
